responsibility: Provides the vectorizer-specific loop CFG and SSA manipulation routines used to reshape loops so they can be vectorized and executed correctly. This file handles peeling and duplication support, SSA renaming across copied blocks, debug-stmt repair, creation and adjustment of loop exits and phis, and loop versioning for runtime alias/alignment/niter conditions, including reuse of if-conversion-created scalar copies and maintenance of loop-closed SSA form for transformed loop nests.
